cinematic_dialogue:2:1826040001:.text: I can't afford to wait any longer.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1826040002:.text: When exactly will the Repair House be back in business?
cinematic_dialogue:2:1826040002:.source_cn: 修缮屋什么时候才能重新开张？

cinematic_dialogue:2:1826040003:.text: There's no point tearing your hair out over this.

say:6:1826041001:1.source_cn: 两位贵族朋友，你们在为什么事而烦恼？

say:7:1826041002:1.text: Excuse me, but I just overheard you mention the Repair House... Is it closed because of a shortage of fresh limbs?
say:7:1826041002:1.source_cn: 我似乎隐约听你们提到了修缮屋……莫非是因为缺少新鲜的断肢？

say:8:1826041003:1.text: No, Novaris has plenty of limbs these days. What we lack is skilled physicians.
say:8:1826041003:1.source_cn: 不，诺珐斯早已不缺肢体供给。现在的问题是没有医师。

say:9:1826041004:1.text: Baba Muriel used to run the Repair House, but she vanished without a trace once Bantus started hunting her. No one knows where she is now.
say:9:1826041004:1.source_cn: 修缮屋以前的医师是穆婆婆，但她被通缉以后，就莫名其妙地...

say:10:1826041005:1.text: For some reason, Her Ladyship has yet to appoint a replacement for Baba Muriel... My knees and wrists can wait, but my eyes can't hold out much longer!
say:10:1826041005:1.source_cn: 不知道为何，领主阁下也没有派遣新的医师接手修缮屋……我...

say:11:1826041006:1.text: Oh? Are there no other physicians in Novaris?
say:11:1826041006:1.source_cn: 哦？诺珐斯城内难道没有其他医师了吗？

say:12:1826041007:1.text: There are, but Baba Muriel was in a league of her own. She was the only physician to receive Her Ladyship's approval, after all.
say:12:1826041007:1.source_cn: 自然是有的，只是他们的技术都不如穆婆婆精湛。毕竟她是唯...

say:13:1826041008:1.text: I'd never entrust my body to those shady back-alley clinics.
say:13:1826041008:1.source_cn: 身为贵族，我是绝不会去那些黑心小作坊接受手术的。

say:15:1826041010:1.text: Rest easy, my friends. <style="highlight">I'll write to King Thoran about your plight</style>, and I'm sure a first-rate physician will be sent your way before long.

say:16:1826041011:1.text: You would do that for us? How warm-hearted of you!
say:16:1826041011:1.source_cn: 哦，真的吗？您可真是一位热心的绅士！

say:17:1826041012:1.text: Heh... People with "warm hearts" have always appealed to me.
say:17:1826041012:1.source_cn: 呵呵……我的确很喜欢“热心”。

say:18:1826041013:1.text: Judging by your attire, you must be a Bantus nobleman. If you can spare the time, I'd love for you to attend my housewarming banquet at the next new moon.
say:18:1826041013:1.source_cn: 这位先生，看您的打扮，应该是来自班题斯的贵族吧？如果您...

say:19:1826041014:1.text: After all, opportunities to befriend a gentleman like you don't come along every day.
say:19:1826041014:1.source_cn: 毕竟，能结交您这样的绅士的机会可不多。

say:20:1826041015:1.text: I'm deeply honored by your invitation.
say:20:1826041015:1.source_cn: 能收到你的邀请，真是我的无上荣幸啊。

say:21:1826041016:1.text: But I have other engagements later. Once I've wrapped things up, I'll certainly stop by your manor.
say:21:1826041016:1.source_cn: 我稍后还有安排，等我的事情结束后，一定前往你的府邸拜访。

say:27:1826041018:1.source_cn: ——真是太棒了！这是我府邸的地址，请您务必收好。

say:28:1826041019:1.text: I look forward to your visit later.
say:28:1826041019:1.source_cn: 那么，我们就在家中恭候您的到来了。

say:32:1826041021:1.text: Tres, I have a few questions. Would you care to enlighten me?
say:32:1826041021:1.source_cn: 我有一些疑问，不知道你能否为我解答。

say:33:1826041022:1.text: That Baba Muriel... Where is she now? I know she isn't in the Imperial Guard's custody.
say:33:1826041022:1.source_cn: 修缮屋原来的医生——那个被通缉的穆婆婆，她去哪了？禁卫...

say:34:1826041023:1.text: My apologies, Viscount Salazer. I only attend to matters within the manor, so I'm unfamiliar with the city's affairs.
say:34:1826041023:1.source_cn: 我只负责莫蒂默庄园内的事务，不清楚城内政务。请您谅解。

say:35:1826041024:1.text: Alright, let me rephrase that. Why hasn't Lady Tephesia found a replacement for Baba Muriel? Or is appointing a physician too much for Lady Tephesia these days?
say:35:1826041024:1.source_cn: 那么我换个问题。为什么穆婆婆失踪了多日，新医师还没有上...

say:37:1826041026:1.text: Rest assured, Her Ladyship is perfectly well. She has a considerable backlog of matters to attend to.
say:37:1826041026:1.source_cn: 您多虑了，领主阁下一切安好。只是因为最近政务繁忙，很多...

say:38:1826041027:1.text: Are you suggesting that she's too lazy to complete her duties?
say:38:1826041027:1.source_cn: 你是想告诉我，是因为她太懒了吗？

say:39:1826041028:1.text: Her Ladyship has always been this way. Everyone is well aware.
say:39:1826041028:1.source_cn: 领主阁下的心性，有目共睹。

say:40:1826041029:1.text: Indeed... which leaves me nothing to argue with.
say:40:1826041029:1.source_cn: 是啊……所以才能令我无从反驳。

say:41:1826041030:1.text: Let's <style="highlight">carry on with the tour</style>. I believe there's plenty more for me to see in Novaris.

narration:43:18060131:0.text: Two nobles in Novaris are fretting over the Repair House's closure. Feigning concern, Salazer approaches them to fish for information.
narration:43:18060131:0.source_cn: 诺珐斯城内，两位贵族正因修缮屋的关闭而烦心不已。斯莱泽...
